design.root_cause: Awake hard-codes the expirable tray tooltip to `MMM d, h:mm tt` in `Manager.SetModeShellIcon`, so users with 24-hour regional settings still see a 12-hour time string.
evidence: Issue #47359 gives a one-step repro: set an expirable time such as 13:30 and observe that the tray text shows 1:30 instead of respecting the user's 24-hour format.
The reporter attached the requested screenshot after a maintainer asked for the tray/settings view.
In `src/modules/awake/Awake/Core/Manager.cs`, `SetModeShellIcon` formats expirable mode with `ExpireAt:MMM d, h:mm tt`, which forces a 12-hour clock regardless of `CultureInfo.CurrentCulture`.

affected_files.purpose: Builds the tray tooltip text for each Awake mode.
New pure helper that formats expiration text with the active culture so it can be unit-tested.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Formatting logic is embedded inline inside `Manager.SetModeShellIcon`, so the tray path always emits a fixed `h:mm tt` pattern and cannot be unit-tested.
implementation_steps.change: Extract a small formatter that composes the localized short-time pattern from `CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.DateTimeFormat.ShortTimePattern`.
edge_cases: 12-hour cultures must continue to show AM/PM markers.
The helper must not mutate thread culture.
tests: Unit-test `en-US` and assert AM/PM output is preserved.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Expirable mode concatenates `Resources.AWAKE_TRAY_UNTIL` with `ExpireAt:MMM d, h:mm tt`.
implementation_steps.change: Replace the inline format string with the shared formatter.
edge_cases: Passive, timed, and indefinite modes must remain unchanged.
Tooltip length must stay within Shell_NotifyIcon limits.
tests: Manual: set Windows to a 24-hour locale and verify the tray tooltip shows `13:30`.
Manual: switch back to a 12-hour locale and verify AM/PM output still appears.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: There is no automated regression coverage for tray expiration formatting.
implementation_steps.change: Add focused tests that call the extracted formatter directly under both 12-hour and 24-hour cultures.
edge_cases: Tests must restore any culture override they apply.
Use a fixed DateTimeOffset so daylight-savings changes cannot make the test flaky.
tests: Run the Awake module services unit tests and confirm both culture-specific cases pass.

verify: Build and run the Awake unit tests that include `AwakeTrayTextFormatterTests`.
Manual: set Windows to a 24-hour locale, enable Awake until 13:30, hover the tray icon, and confirm the tooltip shows `13:30` rather than `1:30`.
Manual: repeat with a 12-hour locale and confirm AM/PM formatting is still correct.
risks: Changing the format string can unintentionally alter the compact tooltip shape for some locales.
The helper must stay tray-thread-safe and avoid UI-thread-only state.
alternatives: Keep the hard-coded format and document the limitation. Rejected because the issue is caused by the hard-coded string itself.
Use a fully localized long date/time pattern. Rejected because the bug is specifically about respecting the short time format.
